department: Applied Mathematics (School of Mathematics and Statistics, FME)

deadline.value: Applications are accepted throughout the academic year under UPC's general rule; the programme page sets no separate date.
deadline.quote: As a general rule, you can apply for a doctoral programme throughout the academic year.

supervisor.value: The Academic Committee decides admission on the CV, record and statement of interest, and assigns the thesis director after admission.
supervisor.quote: The final assignment of the Thesis Director must be made by the Academic Committee of the program after the admission of the doctoral candidate.

funding.value: Admission does not come with a grant; UPC predoctoral grants are awarded through annual general calls.
funding.quote: The admission in the PhD program does not imply any grant.

also.quote: General calls of predoctoral grants, financed by state and autonomous public bodies, the UPC, and private foundations.

entry_route.value: Applicants normally hold a master's degree or are in the final year of one.
entry_route.quote: Holders of a master's degree, or students in the last year of studies of a master's degree, can apply for admission.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject test is mentioned on the programme pages.

notes: Applicants submit the application form with CV, degree transcripts and statement of interest; a foreign degree needs an equivalence to the Spanish system. No English rule is stated on the programme admission page.
name: Applied Mathematics doctoral programme
